fnol_text: My name is Kofi Haddad and I live at 833 Thornbury Lane, Greenville, SC 29642. You can reach me on (555) 913-3676 or kofi.haddad@example.com. On 29 June 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2023-00114. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Haddad on (555) 913-3676 to acknowledge the claim. Kofi confirmed the loss date as 29 June 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Zara Achebe gave a statement by phone.
Kofi sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
